expectations.evidence: "In the US, bridge wind loads come from AASHTO LRFD Bridge Design Specifications Art. 3.8, not ASCE 7 (which addresses buildings and other structures, not highway bridges)." ... "Strength III takes the site value from Fig. 3.8.1.1.2-1, Strength V is 80 mph, Service I 70 mph, Service IV 0.75 × Strength III."

"AASHTO LRFD, 9th ed., Art. 3.8.1.1.2, 3.8.1.2.1, 3.8.1.3, 3.8.3" with units pinned in "PZ = 2.56 × 10⁻⁶ V² KZ G CD (ksf, V in mph)"; and "Code provisions verified against specification text and state DOT design manuals; case-bridge values as cited."
